news.title: Embassy Office Parks REIT’s NOI rises 17% to ₹1,020 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Embassy Office Parks REIT’s consolidated total income increased 16.6 per cent to ₹1,260 crore, while net profit rose 25.8 per cent to ₹195.21 crore. Its manager approved a distribution of ₹598.12 crore, or ₹6.31 per unit.

news.title: Lucknow civic body's 5% property tax rebate ends on July 31
news.para: Lucknow Municipal Corporation has said July 31, 2026, will be the last date for property taxpayers to avail a 5% rebate on house tax payments. The rebate is applicable on both online and offline payments.

news.title: M3M India, Trehan IRIS to invest ₹1,900 crore in Gurugram projects
news.para: M3M India will invest ₹600 crore in a Gurugram commercial development. This project is expected to generate ₹1,500 crore in revenue. Trehan IRIS commits ₹1,300 crore for a Gurugram residential project. The Omara project will offer 320 residences with spacious homes. Both developments are scheduled for completion by the end of 2029.

news.title: Bombay HC grants SEBI time to file affidavits in Embassy REIT matters
news.para: The Bombay High Court on Wednesday granted the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) time to file detailed affidavits in two writ petitions concerning allegations against the Sponsor and promoters of Embassy Office Parks REIT.

news.title: Bihar government to lift curbs on land deals in satellite townships
news.para: Bihar government will lift land sale restrictions in satellite township areas. This move aims to facilitate planned urban expansion and provide relief to landowners. Development plans for these areas are being prioritized for final notification. Land transactions will be permitted under a regulated planning framework after plans are in force. This decision promotes transparent land management and encourages investment in new cities.

news.title: Lucknow: LDA makes fire safety certificates mandatory for building map approval
news.para: Building map approvals in Lucknow now require mandatory fire safety certificates.  Commercial and public-use buildings must submit a valid fire NOC before approval.  Smaller buildings will submit affidavits and undergo audits within three months.  This new rule applies to various establishments like hotels and schools.  The LDA aims to enhance fire safety before construction commences.

news.title: Jaipur development body's new fire NOC rule slows building plan approvals
news.para: Jaipur Development Authority building plan approvals have slowed significantly. A new order mandates Fire No Objection Certificates before final sanction. Architects express confusion and uncertainty regarding the revised approval process. This change follows the implementation of a new fire safety act. Fire officials also question the feasibility of issuing NOCs without inspections.

news.title: Construction waste plant in Gurugram faces heat over approval, tree-felling charges
news.para: Residents near a proposed construction waste plant in Gurgaon reported tree felling.  The Haryana Pollution Control Board has not received any plant proposal.  Local authorities awarded a contract for boundary fencing and a waste dump site.  Residents have filed a complaint seeking an investigation into alleged violations.  Concerns persist regarding health impacts and adherence to environmental laws.

news.title: Delhi civic body demolishes 14 unauthorised properties, seals one
news.para: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi demolished fourteen unauthorized properties and sealed one more.  Civic officials also issued sixteen show-cause notices for illegal construction activities.  This action is part of an ongoing citywide enforcement drive against building norm violations.  Since June first, the civic body has demolished 681 properties.  Residents are urged to obtain necessary approvals before undertaking any construction work.

news.title: RWA moves NGT against SEIAA stand on Amaltash environmental clearance in Gurugram
news.para: The National Green Tribunal is hearing a challenge to Haryana's environmental clearance for a Gurugram project.  Amaltash Residential Welfare Association has four weeks to file objections to a compliance report.  SEIAA granted clearance despite recommendations for a fresh traffic impact assessment.  A committee found traffic management relied on internal roads through residential areas.  The tribunal will next hear the matter on October sixteenth.

news.title: Tamil Nadu registration dept to classify streets into three categories based on electricity connections
news.para: Tamil Nadu's registration department is correcting market value guideline anomalies. Streets will now be classified based on commercial electricity connections. This aims to reduce the gap between guideline and actual market values. Inconsistencies in valuations of roads and adjoining areas will be reviewed. Manpower shortages may affect the implementation of these important changes.

news.title: Gujarat: Real estate projects hit as new appraisal panel not formed
news.para: Real estate project clearances in Gujarat have slowed significantly. The State-level Expert Appraisal Committee's tenure ended in June, causing delays. Industry representatives have raised concerns with the state government. Many project approvals are currently stuck without a functioning committee. The formation of a new committee is reportedly in its final stages.

news.title: NAB home-loan applications fall 15% as Australian housing market cools
news.para: National Australia Bank saw home loan applications drop fifteen percent.  Business lending showed early stress, particularly in Middle East conflict-affected sectors.  Watch loans increased eight percent, indicating growing customer strain.  Asset quality pressure remained evident in construction and transport industries.  Impaired loans improved, showing active management of bad debts.

news.title: Prestige Estates Projects’ net profit declines 13% to ₹271.40 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Prestige Estates Projects’ consolidated total income increased 14.9 per cent to ₹2,835.60 crore. Its sales value declined 46 per cent year-on-year to ₹6,579.30 crore, while collections rose six per cent to ₹4,802.20 crore.

news.title: Brigade acquires two acres land in Bengaluru; Prestige to develop 14.6 acres land in Thane
news.para: Brigade Group has acquired land on Kanakapura Road for a premium residential project. This new development is estimated to have a gross development value of ₹400 crore. Meanwhile, Prestige Group announced a partnership for a large residential project in Thane. This Thane project will span over fourteen acres and has a GDV of ₹6,000 crore. The development of this significant project is expected to occur in multiple phases.

news.title: EFC (I)’s net profit rises 52% to ₹70.85 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: EFC (I)'s consolidated total income increased 31.8 per cent to ₹294.29 crore during the quarter. Its board has also approved the demerger of the asset-light managed office business of its wholly owned subsidiary, EFC.

news.title: Bajaj Housing Finance’s net profit rises 23% to ₹715.28 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Bajaj Housing Finance's total income increased 17.1 per cent to ₹3,063.05 crore during the quarter. Its assets under management grew 24 per cent year-on-year to ₹1,49,624 crore.

news.title: Asian Paints’ net profit rises 40% to ₹1,559.45 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Asian Paints' consolidated total income increased 18.1 per cent to ₹10,782.79 crore during the quarter. Its decorative paints business in India reported volume growth of nine per cent and value growth of 16.6 per cent.
